LESSON: FISHING IN KENYA • LAKE VICTORIA • LAKE TURKANA • LAKE NAIVASHA • RIVER TANA AND RIVER ATHI

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Resources and Economic Activities
Topic 3.3: Fishing in Kenya • Lake Victoria • Lake Turkana • Lake Naivasha • River Tana and River Athi
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Fishing in Kenya • Lake Victoria • Lake Turkana • Lake Naivasha • River Tana and River Athi, part of Resources and Economic Activities in Grade 5 SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: Why is fishing important in our country?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. brainstorm on the main inland fishing grounds in Kenya using digital resources/print media,

2. draw a map of Kenya showing the main inland fishing grounds,

3. find out from relevant sources in groups the contribution of fishing to the economy of Kenya and write a summary,

4. engage with a resource person to discuss the contribution of fishing to the economy of Kenya and report in class,

5. develop posters on the importance of fishing in Kenya and share.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. brainstorm on the main inland fishing grounds in Kenya using digital resources/print media,
2. draw a map of Kenya showing the main inland fishing grounds,
3. find out from relevant sources in groups the contribution of fishing to the economy of Kenya and write a summary,
4. engage with a resource person to discuss the contribution of fishing to the economy of Kenya and report in class,
5. develop posters on the importance of fishing in Kenya and share.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Fishing in Kenya • Lake Victoria • Lake Turkana • Lake Naivasha • River Tana and River Athi together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-Efficacy: Learners show attention to detail as they discuss in groups methods of inland fishing in Kenya and

report in class.

● Citizenship: Learners demonstrate creativity as they develop posters, in pairs, on the importance of fishing in

Kenya and share with members of the community.

Values:
● Unity: Learners take turns in activities as they illustrate in groups fishing methods used in Kenya, display in class

and do a gallery walk to appreciate each other’s work.

● Respect: Learners show positive regard for self and others as they find out from relevant sources in groups the

contribution of fishing to the economy of Kenya and write a summary.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Creativity thinking skills: Learners enhance the skills of creative thinking as they draw a map of Kenya showing the main

inland fishing grounds.

Link to other learning areas:

The learner is able to apply Agriculture skills as they find out from relevant sources the contribution of fishing to the economy

of Kenya and write a summary.
